title: fix: make keyboard focus visible in light and dark mode
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Updated shared UI controls to make keyboard focus easier to see in light and dark themes. A dedicated focus color replaces shadow-based rings with 2px outlines for text fields, buttons, cards and links; sliders show focus around the thumb rather than the track. Error fields and danger controls keep distinct focus colors, while filled buttons retain their filled appearance. The stylesheet now hides closed dialogs, drawers and menus even when an app does not load preflight styles. Bumped @pollinations/ui from 0.1.0-alpha.15 to 0.1.0-alpha.16.
